description: Access audit for bulk VOC / breath databases suggested as alternatives to Owlstone VOC Atlas en-masse download.

sources.name: Human Breathomics Database
sources.access: Live site Cloudflare-blocked for automated scrape. Open Zenodo SQL dump hbdb2_wo_sentences.sql (10.5281/zenodo.14958797) is the bulk path; see HBDB scrape PR.
sources.notes: Google-style BeautifulSoup scrape of hbdb.cmdm.tw fails with 403 here.

sources.name: Clinical Breathomics Dataset (Scientific Data / Figshare)
sources.access: Anonymous Figshare file download (peak CSVs + metadata xlsx).

sources.name: Breath Biopsy VOC Atlas (Owlstone)
sources.access: Registration required. License bars AI training / fine-tuning / validation — do not ingest into ExhalePath ML calibrator.

sources.name: PhysioNet respiratory / vital-sign databases
sources.access: Public database listing; waveform dumps are large and out of VOC scope.
sources.notes: Useful for breathing-pattern models, not breath VOC panels.

sources.name: BreathBase® Data (Breathomix)
sources.access: No public CSV/ZIP; access via vendor contact / partnership.

sources.name: Human Metabolome Database
sources.access: Live hmdb.ca is Cloudflare-blocked; bulk XML is available from the Wishart fix mirror https://hmdbfix.wishartlab.com/system/downloads/current/hmdb_metabolites.zip (217920 metabolites; 60 Breath-tagged). See ds02 + scripts/extract_hmdb_wishart.py.

sources.name: Human Breath Atlas (Shirley Diagnostics)
sources.access: No public bulk export found on the marketing site.

sources.name: Zenodo open breathomics adjunct datasets
sources.modality: feature lists / sampling variability / HBDB eval texts
